questions: Which of these four came first?
Volvo Cars (founded 1927) is the earliest of the four.
Which of these four is biggest by area?
Sumatra has the greatest area of the four (473,481 km2).
Formed in 1967 and later reuniting from 2002 to 2009, this pioneering Japanese boy band was among Johnny & Associates' very first acts — which group?
Four Leaves (F Rbusu) was a Japanese boy band from the talent agency Johnny & Associates.
In what year was Muslim Brotherhood founded?
Muslim Brotherhood: The group later advanced into the political arena, aiming to end British colonial rule in Egypt.
Holder of the Serie A record for goals scored from free kicks, this Serbian defender won the European Cup with Red Star Belgrade in 1991 before starring in Italy — who is he?
Siniša Mihajlović: Serbian footballer and manager (1969–2022)

Winner of the 1989 Hugo Award, this 1989 science fiction book borrows its structure from The Canterbury Tales as pilgrims journey toward the Time Tombs to petition a wish-granting creature called the Shrike — which book?
Hyperion (Simmons novel) is a 1989 science fiction novel by American author Dan Simmons.

This British Formula One engineer, widely regarded as one of the sport's greatest designers, has served as technical chief at Williams, McLaren, and Red Bull, and now co-owns Aston Martin's F1 team — who is he?
Adrian Newey (born 26 December 1958) is a British engineer, aerodynamicist, automotive designer, and motorsport executive.
